# Module 15 — streams

Allowed: modules 1–14, plus `Stream`, `map`, `filter`, `collect`, `reduce`, `sorted`, `distinct`, and `flatMap`.

A parallel stream is allowed only when the task asks for parallel processing. Do not require it otherwise.

Do not suggest or require: `Thread`, `Runnable`, `synchronized`, executors, file I/O, or web APIs.
